body.label: Target
body.html: Your visible Locked target within ranged Weapon Range.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Trigger: The target declares a defensive Action, before its benefits apply. Response: On success, deal 2 weapon Damage before that Action continues.

surges.html: After a hit, end Lock to suppress 1 point of the declared Action's ordinary defensive bonus until the start of your next turn. The Action is not canceled.
